verdict.rationale: Idempotent retries are a fair question to ask of a payments API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions idempotency keys, a safe-retry mechanism or duplicate-charge protection. The items are only titles of payment, refund, 3DS and webhook guides, plus probes of llms.txt and missing OpenAPI files.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges
